title: The farm dog
text: A farm dog sleeps lightly beside the barn. At night it guards the yard and barks when a fox comes near the hens. In the morning the farmer rewards it with a bone.

title: Foxes at dusk
text: The fox leaves its den at dusk and hunts alone along the edge of the forest. It listens for mice under the grass and jumps on them with both paws.

title: Sheep in the hills
text: In summer the shepherd moves the sheep to the high meadow, where the grass is thick. Two dogs keep the flock together, and every goat that wanders off is brought back before dark.

title: Baking bread
text: To bake bread you mix flour, water, salt and yeast, then let the dough rise for an hour. The loaf goes into a hot oven until the crust turns golden and sounds hollow when tapped.

title: A pot of soup
text: A good soup starts with onions cooked slowly in butter. Add chopped vegetables and water, let the pot simmer, and taste for salt before serving it warm in a bowl.

title: How cheese is made
text: Cheese begins as warm milk that is curdled and cut into small pieces. The curd is pressed into a round shape, salted, and left to age on wooden shelves in a cool cellar.

title: The morning bus
text: The first bus leaves the station at six and is crowded with workers by the third stop. The driver knows most passengers by name and waits a moment for those who run along the street.

title: Night trains
text: A night train crosses the country while its passengers sleep in narrow beds. It stops at small stations in the dark, and the engine is changed at the border before sunrise.

title: Cycling to work
text: Riding a bicycle to work is often faster than the car in a busy city. A rider needs good brakes, lights for the evening, and a safe lane away from the trucks on the main road.

title: Mixing paint
text: With three tubes of paint you can mix most colours. Blue and yellow give green, red and yellow give orange, and a little white makes any shade paler on the palette.

title: Autumn leaves
text: In autumn the leaves stop making the pigment that keeps them green. Yellow and brown tones that were hidden all summer appear, and some trees turn deep red before the leaves fall.

title: Choosing a wall colour
text: A pale colour makes a small room feel larger, while a dark wall brings the ceiling down. Painters test a patch near the window first, because the same grey looks different in daylight and at night.

title: A summer storm
text: A summer storm builds during a hot afternoon. Dark clouds pile up, the wind turns cold, and then thunder, lightning and heavy rain arrive together. Half an hour later the sky is clear again.

title: Morning fog
text: Fog forms in the valley when damp air cools during a calm night. By morning the river and the fields are hidden, and the fog lifts only when the sun warms the ground.

title: The first snow
text: The first snow of winter usually falls at night and melts by noon. Real cold comes later, when frost hardens the ground and the snow stays on the hills for weeks.

title: Learning the piano
text: A beginner at the piano learns scales with one hand and then with both. Ten minutes of slow practice every day does more than a long lesson once a week, and a simple tune keeps the student interested.

title: The street band
text: On Saturdays a small band plays in the square: a trumpet, a drum and an old banjo. People stop to listen, children dance, and coins fall into the open guitar case.

title: Tuning a guitar
text: A guitar has six strings, and each one is tuned by turning a peg until the note is right. Musicians tune before every concert, because heat and damp air pull the strings out of tune.

title: A slow laptop
text: A laptop becomes slow when too many programs run at once and the memory fills up. Closing unused software, restarting the computer and installing the latest update usually bring the speed back.

title: The office printer
text: The office printer jams whenever the paper is damp. The technician opens the side door, pulls out the crumpled sheet, and reminds everyone to keep the paper tray closed.

title: Backing up files
text: A backup is a second copy of your files kept somewhere else. If the disk of the server fails, or a laptop is stolen, the copy on another machine saves months of work.

title: The night nurse
text: A night nurse walks the quiet corridors of the hospital and checks each patient every two hours. She gives medicine, writes notes for the doctor, and calls for help if someone gets worse.

title: The village teacher
text: The village school has one teacher for children of every age. She explains reading to the youngest while the older pupils solve problems, and in the afternoon everyone works in the garden.

title: Before take-off
text: Before take-off a pilot reads a checklist aloud: fuel, flaps, instruments, radio. The habit looks slow, but it catches the small mistakes that a tired crew would miss on a busy airport.

title: Tides
text: The sea rises and falls twice a day because the moon pulls on the water. At low tide the beach grows wide and the boats in the harbour rest on the sand.

title: Bees and honey
text: Bees collect nectar from flowers and carry it to the hive. There they fan it with their wings until it thickens into honey, which feeds the colony through the winter.

title: Why we sleep
text: During sleep the body repairs muscles and the brain sorts the memories of the day. People who sleep too little for a week react more slowly and make more mistakes.

title: Recycling glass
text: Glass can be melted and shaped again without losing quality. Bottles are sorted by colour, crushed, cleaned and heated in a furnace, which uses less energy than making new glass from sand.

title: A game of chess
text: Chess is played on a board of sixty-four squares. Each player starts with sixteen pieces and tries to trap the king of the opponent, thinking several moves ahead.

title: Planting a tree
text: A young tree is planted in a hole twice as wide as its roots. Water it well in the first summer and tie it to a stake so that strong wind does not bend the trunk.
